title: harnesses.toml
description:
The Harnesses this machine starts Threads with, in this order.
Without the file, Banda starts Claude Code and Codex, each with the
Person's own CLI.

HarnessEntry.description:
One `[[harness]]` table. An entry with the ID of a Harness Banda
knows, `claude` or `codex`, takes each key it leaves out from Banda:
so a Banda that moves an adapter to a newer version moves this
machine's too. Any other ID needs a `name` and a `command`.

id.description: How Threads and the window name it: `claude`, `codex`.

command.description: The program that speaks ACP: its name on PATH, or its path.

enabled.description:
Whether Threads start with it. One turned off stays in the list,
with how it starts, for when it is turned on again.

env.description: Variables over the environment it starts in.

cli.description: The Person's own CLI the program runs, when it runs one.

start.description: What a new Thread on it starts with.

Cli.description:
A CLI the Person installed, which an adapter runs in place of a copy
of its own (ADR 0003, decision 3).

program.description: Its name on PATH, or its path.

variable.description:
The variable that tells the adapter where it is: Claude Code's
`CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE`, Codex's `CODEX_PATH`.

minimum.description:
The oldest version the adapter supports: the one it was built for.
An older CLI still runs, and its Threads warn.

Start.description:
What a new Thread on a Harness starts with, over the Harness's own:
what it leaves out, the Harness chooses.

mode.description:
How freely its Agent acts: "supervised", "accept_edits", "auto" or
"full_access".

plan.description: The Agent makes a plan before it changes anything.

Mode.description:
How freely an Agent acts in a Thread (ADR 0003, decision 9). A Harness
that has modes of its own enforces the mode; for any other, the engine
answers the Harness's Questions by it.

oneOf.description: It asks before it changes anything.
It edits files without asking, and asks before anything else.
It decides itself what to ask about.

OptionValue.description: A value of one of the Harness's options: a choice's ID, or on or off.
